lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
photos-main: 986 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/paths 508 B, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B, vue-demi 37 B.
photos-public: 782 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B, @nextcloud/paths 341 B.
photos-dashboard: 782 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B, @nextcloud/paths 341 B.
moment, 292,533 B on the photos-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,719 B on the photos-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
1 delivered file carries no source map, so those bytes are counted but charged to no package.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (142 packages, 638 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
